name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Matej Tonin
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided not to lift the legal immunity of Matej Tonin, a Slovenian member. Slovenia's public prosecutor wants to charge him over claims that, as a member of a Slovenian parliamentary oversight committee in 2023, he misused his position to get police information about wiretapping. The Parliament's legal affairs committee found concerns about the timing of the investigation and the request that it could not clear up. The Parliament is not a court and has not judged whether he is guilty.

- No immunity waiver: Tonin keeps protection from prosecution for now.
- Affects Tonin and Slovenian prosecutors wanting to charge him.
- Parliament tells Slovenia and Tonin of the decision; prosecutors must decide how to proceed.
